law.text:
Unless limited by a corporation's articles of incorporation:
An officer of the corporation is entitled to mandatory indemnification under § 13.1-877, and is entitled to apply for court-ordered indemnification under § 13.1-879.1, in each case to the same extent as a director; and
The corporation may indemnify and advance expenses under this article to an officer of the corporation to the same extent as to a director.
